editorial:
After a mysterious disease wipes out most of America's kids, the survivors develop strange powers and get locked away in government camps. You follow Ruby, a 16-year-old who escapes and teams up with a small group of teens on the run. The vibe is very much like other young adult dystopian stories, with a mix of road trip adventure and teen romance. It's easy to follow and moves quickly, so you won't get bored even if the story feels familiar.

The acting is decent, especially from the lead, and the action scenes are fun enough for a casual watch. On the downside, the plot is predictable and the world-building feels thin. If you enjoy teen sci-fi adventures, you'll probably have a good time, but don't expect anything groundbreaking. It's best enjoyed as a light weekend watch. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Ruby learns the truth about the government's plans and the leader of the resistance. She discovers that one of her friends has been working against them all along. Ruby uses her powers to erase the memories of the people she cares about to protect them, then walks away alone. The twist reveals that the real enemy was closer than anyone thought, setting up a darker future.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves young adult dystopian adventures and teen superpower stories.
